paragraphs: Careers In Government runs a job board that connects candidates with roles in state and local government, education, and public service. Listings span titles from city managers and public health nurses to urban planners and environmental engineers.

Job seekers get free access to search postings, upload resumes, and reach public sector employers directly. Filters narrow results by location, salary, classification, or job type. Employers buy recruitment packages that include unlimited annual memberships, resume database access, and job postings. The company says those tools integrate with an agency applicant tracking system and support compliance.

The company dates its work in this market to 1996. It describes the platform as built by former public sector professionals. Visitors to the home page can sign up to have job alerts sent to their inbox.

quote.text: Built by former public sector professionals
